significance: Jaipur's principal Krishna temple, set in the City Palace complex around images that Sawai Jai Singh II brought from Vrindavan. It is also where Baladeva Vidyabhushana composed the Govinda Bhashya, a foundational Gaudiya Vaishnava commentary.
story: The image is said to have been made by Bajranabh, Krishna's great-grandson, as one of three portraying his feet, chest and face.
